models_evaluated: FDA-approved AI echocardiographic HFpEF detection tool (apical 4-chamber video)

links.outcome: Negative predictive value and sensitivity of AI HFpEF detection versus invasive haemodynamics
links.effect: Sensitivity 30%, specificity 88%, PPV 86%, NPV 33% (exercise RHC, n=28); with PCWP/CO slope, sensitivity 27%, NPV 16%. Negative AI results cannot exclude HFpEF.
links.quote: Due to limited sensitivity, the tool is best utilized to enrich identification of patients with clearly abnormal haemodynamics rather than to exclude HFpEF, particularly in early or borderline cases.

screen.reason: This is an external validation study of an FDA-approved echocardiographic AI tool against invasive hemodynamic criteria in a real-world cohort. It evaluates diagnostic accuracy but does not test a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
